ayahs.arabicText: قَدْ اَفْلَحَ الْمُؤْمِنُوْنَۙ
ayahs.translation: The believers have indeed attained true success:

ayahs.arabicText: الَّذِیْنَ هُمْ فِیْ صَلَاتِهِمْ خٰشِعُوْنَۙ
ayahs.translation: those who, in their Prayers, humble themselves;

ayahs.arabicText: وَ الَّذِیْنَ هُمْ عَنِ اللَّغْوِ مُعْرِضُوْنَۙ
ayahs.translation: who avoid whatever is vain and frivolous;

ayahs.arabicText: وَ الَّذِیْنَ هُمْ لِلزَّكٰوةِ فٰعِلُوْنَۙ
ayahs.translation: who observe Zakah;

ayahs.arabicText: وَ الَّذِیْنَ هُمْ لِفُرُوْجِهِمْ حٰفِظُوْنَۙ
ayahs.translation: who strictly guard their private parts

ayahs.arabicText: اِلَّا عَلٰۤى اَزْوَاجِهِمْ اَوْ مَا مَلَكَتْ اَیْمَانُهُمْ فَاِنَّهُمْ غَیْرُ مَلُوْمِیْنَۚ
ayahs.translation: save from their wives, or those whom their right hands possess; for with regard to them they are free from blame "

ayahs.arabicText: فَمَنِ ابْتَغٰى وَرَآءَ ذٰلِكَ فَاُولٰٓئِكَ هُمُ الْعٰدُوْنَۚ
ayahs.translation: As for those who seek beyond that, they are transgressors"

ayahs.arabicText: وَ الَّذِیْنَ هُمْ لِاَمٰنٰتِهِمْ وَ عَهْدِهِمْ رٰعُوْنَۙ
ayahs.translation: who are true to their trusts and their covenants,

ayahs.arabicText: وَ الَّذِیْنَ هُمْ عَلٰى صَلَوٰتِهِمْ یُحَافِظُوْنَۘ
ayahs.translation: and who guard their Prayers.

ayahs.arabicText: اُولٰٓئِكَ هُمُ الْوٰرِثُوْنَۙ
ayahs.translation: Such are the inheritors

ayahs.arabicText: الَّذِیْنَ یَرِثُوْنَ الْفِرْدَوْسَ١ؕ هُمْ فِیْهَا خٰلِدُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: that shall inherit Paradise; and in it they shall abide for ever.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ لَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا الْاِنْسَانَ مِنْ سُلٰلَةٍ مِّنْ طِیْنٍۚ
ayahs.translation: We created man out of the extract of clay,

ayahs.arabicText: ثُمَّ جَعَلْنٰهُ نُطْفَةً فِیْ قَرَارٍ مَّكِیْنٍ۪
ayahs.translation: then We made him into a drop of life-germ, then We placed it in a safe depository,

ayahs.arabicText: ثُمَّ خَلَقْنَا النُّطْفَةَ عَلَقَةً فَخَلَقْنَا الْعَلَقَةَ مُضْغَةً فَخَلَقْنَا الْمُضْغَةَ عِظٰمًا فَكَسَوْنَا الْعِظٰمَ لَحْمًا١ۗ ثُمَّ اَنْشَاْنٰهُ خَلْقًا اٰخَرَ١ؕ فَتَبٰرَكَ اللّٰهُ اَحْسَنُ الْخٰلِقِیْنَؕ
ayahs.translation: then We made this drop into a clot, then We made the clot into a lump, then We made the lump into bones, then We clothed the bones with flesh, and then We caused it to grow into another creation. Thus Most Blessed is Allah, the Best of all those that create.

ayahs.arabicText: ثُمَّ اِنَّكُمْ بَعْدَ ذٰلِكَ لَمَیِّتُوْنَؕ
ayahs.translation: Thereafter you are destined to die,

ayahs.arabicText: ثُمَّ اِنَّكُمْ یَوْمَ الْقِیٰمَةِ تُبْعَثُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: and then on the Day of Resurrection you shall certainly be raised up.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ لَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا فَوْقَكُمْ سَبْعَ طَرَآئِقَ١ۖۗ وَ مَا كُنَّا عَنِ الْخَلْقِ غٰفِلِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: We have indeed fashioned above you seven paths. Never were We unaware of the task of creation.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اَنْزَلْنَا مِنَ السَّمَآءِ مَآءًۢ بِقَدَرٍ فَاَسْكَنّٰهُ فِی الْاَرْضِ١ۖۗ وَ اِنَّا عَلٰى ذَهَابٍۭ بِهٖ لَقٰدِرُوْنَۚ
ayahs.translation: We sent down water from the sky in right measure, and caused it to stay in the earth, and We have the power to cause it to vanish (in the manner We please).

ayahs.arabicText: فَاَنْشَاْنَا لَكُمْ بِهٖ جَنّٰتٍ مِّنْ نَّخِیْلٍ وَّ اَعْنَابٍ١ۘ لَكُمْ فِیْهَا فَوَاكِهُ كَثِیْرَةٌ وَّ مِنْهَا تَاْكُلُوْنَۙ
ayahs.translation: Then through water We caused gardens of date-palms and vines to grow for you wherein you have an abundance of delicious fruits and from them you derive your livelihood.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ شَجَرَةً تَخْرُجُ مِنْ طُوْرِ سَیْنَآءَ تَنْۢبُتُ بِالدُّهْنِ وَ صِبْغٍ لِّلْاٰكِلِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: And We also produced the tree which springs forth from Mount Sinai, containing oil and sauce for those that eat.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اِنَّ لَكُمْ فِی الْاَنْعَامِ لَعِبْرَةً١ؕ نُسْقِیْكُمْ مِّمَّا فِیْ بُطُوْنِهَا وَ لَكُمْ فِیْهَا مَنَافِعُ كَثِیْرَةٌ وَّ مِنْهَا تَاْكُلُوْنَۙ
ayahs.translation: And indeed there is also a lesson for you in cattle. We provide you with drink out of what they have in their bellies; and you have many other benefits in them: you eat of them,

ayahs.arabicText: وَ عَلَیْهَا وَ عَلَى الْفُلْكِ تُحْمَلُوْنَ۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: and are carried on them and also on ships.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ لَقَدْ اَرْسَلْنَا نُوْحًا اِلٰى قَوْمِهٖ فَقَالَ یٰقَوْمِ اعْبُدُوا اللّٰهَ مَا لَكُمْ مِّنْ اِلٰهٍ غَیْرُهٗ١ؕ اَفَلَا تَتَّقُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: We sent Noah to his people, and he said: "My people! Serve Allah; you have no deity other than He. Do you have no fear?"

ayahs.arabicText: فَقَالَ الْمَلَؤُا الَّذِیْنَ كَفَرُوْا مِنْ قَوْمِهٖ مَا هٰذَاۤ اِلَّا بَشَرٌ مِّثْلُكُمْ١ۙ یُرِیْدُ اَنْ یَّتَفَضَّلَ عَلَیْكُمْ١ؕ وَ لَوْ شَآءَ اللّٰهُ لَاَنْزَلَ مَلٰٓئِكَةً١ۖۚ مَّا سَمِعْنَا بِهٰذَا فِیْۤ اٰبَآئِنَا الْاَوَّلِیْنَۚ
ayahs.translation: But the notables among his people had refused to believe, and said: "This is none other than a mortal like yourselves who desires to attain superiority over you. Had Allah wanted (to send any Messengers) He would have sent down angels. We have heard nothing like this in the time of our forebears of old (that humans were sent as Messengers).

ayahs.arabicText: اِنْ هُوَ اِلَّا رَجُلٌۢ بِهٖ جِنَّةٌ فَتَرَبَّصُوْا بِهٖ حَتّٰى حِیْنٍ
ayahs.translation: He is a person who has been seized with a little madness; so wait for a while (perhaps he will improve)."

ayahs.arabicText: قَالَ رَبِّ انْصُرْنِیْ بِمَا كَذَّبُوْنِ
ayahs.translation: Noah said: "My Lord! Come to my help at their accusation that I am lying."

ayahs.arabicText: فَاَوْحَیْنَاۤ اِلَیْهِ اَنِ اصْنَعِ الْفُلْكَ بِاَعْیُنِنَا وَ وَحْیِنَا فَاِذَا جَآءَ اَمْرُنَا وَ فَارَ التَّنُّوْرُ١ۙ فَاسْلُكْ فِیْهَا مِنْ كُلٍّ زَوْجَیْنِ اثْنَیْنِ وَ اَهْلَكَ اِلَّا مَنْ سَبَقَ عَلَیْهِ الْقَوْلُ مِنْهُمْ١ۚ وَ لَا تُخَاطِبْنِیْ فِی الَّذِیْنَ ظَلَمُوْا١ۚ اِنَّهُمْ مُّغْرَقُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Thereupon We revealed to him, saying: "Build the Ark under Our eyes and according to Our revelation. And when Our command comes to pass and the oven boils over, take on board a pair each from every species, and also take your household except those of them against whom sentence has already been passed and do not plead to Me on behalf of the wrong-doers. They are doomed to be drowned.

ayahs.arabicText: فَاِذَا اسْتَوَیْتَ اَنْتَ وَ مَنْ مَّعَكَ عَلَى الْفُلْكِ فَقُلِ الْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ الَّذِیْ نَجّٰىنَا مِنَ الْقَوْمِ الظّٰلِمِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: And then when you and those accompanying you are firmly seated in the Ark, say: "Thanks be to Allah Who has delivered us from the wrong-doing people."

ayahs.arabicText: وَ قُلْ رَّبِّ اَنْزِلْنِیْ مُنْزَلًا مُّبٰرَكًا وَّ اَنْتَ خَیْرُ الْمُنْزِلِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: And say: "My Lord! Make my landing a blessed landing, for You are the Best of those Who can cause people to land in safety."

ayahs.arabicText: اِنَّ فِیْ ذٰلِكَ لَاٰیٰتٍ وَّ اِنْ كُنَّا لَمُبْتَلِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: There are great Signs in this story; and surely We do put people to test.

ayahs.arabicText: ثُمَّ اَنْشَاْنَا مِنْۢ بَعْدِهِمْ قَرْنًا اٰخَرِیْنَۚ
ayahs.translation: Then, after them, We brought forth another generation;

ayahs.arabicText: فَاَرْسَلْنَا فِیْهِمْ رَسُوْلًا مِّنْهُمْ اَنِ اعْبُدُوا اللّٰهَ مَا لَكُمْ مِّنْ اِلٰهٍ غَیْرُهٗ١ؕ اَفَلَا تَتَّقُوْنَ۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: and We sent among them a Messenger from among themselves, saying: "Serve Allah; you have no god other than He. Do you have no fear?"

ayahs.arabicText: وَ قَالَ الْمَلَاُ مِنْ قَوْمِهِ الَّذِیْنَ كَفَرُوْا وَ كَذَّبُوْا بِلِقَآءِ الْاٰخِرَةِ وَ اَتْرَفْنٰهُمْ فِی الْحَیٰوةِ الدُّنْیَا١ۙ مَا هٰذَاۤ اِلَّا بَشَرٌ مِّثْلُكُمْ١ۙ یَاْكُلُ مِمَّا تَاْكُلُوْنَ مِنْهُ وَ یَشْرَبُ مِمَّا تَشْرَبُوْنَ۪ۙ
ayahs.translation: The notables among his people who had refused to believe and who denied the meeting of the Hereafter, and those whom We had endowed with ease and comfort in this life, cried out: "This is no other than a mortal like yourselves who eats what you eat and drinks what you drink.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ لَئِنْ اَطَعْتُمْ بَشَرًا مِّثْلَكُمْ اِنَّكُمْ اِذًا لَّخٰسِرُوْنَۙ
ayahs.translation: If you were to obey a human being like yourselves, you will certainly be losers.

ayahs.arabicText: اَیَعِدُكُمْ اَنَّكُمْ اِذَا مِتُّمْ وَ كُنْتُمْ تُرَابًا وَّ عِظَامًا اَنَّكُمْ مُّخْرَجُوْنَ۪ۙ
ayahs.translation: Does he promise you that when you are dead and are reduced to dust and bones, you will be brought forth to life?

ayahs.arabicText: هَیْهَاتَ هَیْهَاتَ لِمَا تُوْعَدُوْنَ۪ۙ
ayahs.translation: Far-fetched, utterly far-fetched is what you are being promised.

ayahs.arabicText: اِنْ هِیَ اِلَّا حَیَاتُنَا الدُّنْیَا نَمُوْتُ وَ نَحْیَا وَ مَا نَحْنُ بِمَبْعُوْثِیْنَ۪ۙ
ayahs.translation: There is no other life than the life of the world. We shall live here and here shall we die; and we are not going to be raised again.

ayahs.arabicText: اِنْ هُوَ اِلَّا رَجُلُ اِ۟فْتَرٰى عَلَى اللّٰهِ كَذِبًا وَّ مَا نَحْنُ لَهٗ بِمُؤْمِنِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: This man has forged a mere lie in the name of Allah and we shall never believe what he says."

ayahs.arabicText: قَالَ رَبِّ انْصُرْنِیْ بِمَا كَذَّبُوْنِ
ayahs.translation: The Messenger said: "My Lord! Come to my help at their accusing me of lying."

ayahs.arabicText: قَالَ عَمَّا قَلِیْلٍ لَّیُصْبِحُنَّ نٰدِمِیْنَۚ
ayahs.translation: He answered: "A short while, and they shall be repenting."

ayahs.arabicText: فَاَخَذَتْهُمُ الصَّیْحَةُ بِالْحَقِّ فَجَعَلْنٰهُمْ غُثَآءً١ۚ فَبُعْدًا لِّلْقَوْمِ الظّٰلِمِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: Then a mighty blast quite justly overtook them, and We reduced them to a rubble. So away with the wrong-doing folk!

ayahs.arabicText: ثُمَّ اَنْشَاْنَا مِنْۢ بَعْدِهِمْ قُرُوْنًا اٰخَرِیْنَؕ
ayahs.translation: Then, after them, We brought forth other generations.

ayahs.arabicText: مَا تَسْبِقُ مِنْ اُمَّةٍ اَجَلَهَا وَ مَا یَسْتَاْخِرُوْنَؕ
ayahs.translation: No nation can outstrip its term, nor can it put it back.

ayahs.arabicText: ثُمَّ اَرْسَلْنَا رُسُلَنَا تَتْرَا١ؕ كُلَّمَا جَآءَ اُمَّةً رَّسُوْلُهَا كَذَّبُوْهُ فَاَتْبَعْنَا بَعْضَهُمْ بَعْضًا وَّ جَعَلْنٰهُمْ اَحَادِیْثَ١ۚ فَبُعْدًا لِّقَوْمٍ لَّا یُؤْمِنُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Then We sent Our Messengers in succession. Whenever a Messenger came to his people they rejected him, calling him a liar. Thereupon, We made each people to follow the other (to its doom), reducing them to mere tales (of the past). Scourged be the people who do not believe!

ayahs.arabicText: ثُمَّ اَرْسَلْنَا مُوْسٰى وَ اَخَاهُ هٰرُوْنَ١ۙ۬ بِاٰیٰتِنَا وَ سُلْطٰنٍ مُّبِیْنٍۙ
ayahs.translation: Then We sent Moses and his brother Aaron with Our Signs and a clear authority

ayahs.arabicText: اِلٰى فِرْعَوْنَ وَ مَلَاۡئِهٖ فَاسْتَكْبَرُوْا وَ كَانُوْا قَوْمًا عَالِیْنَۚ
ayahs.translation: to Pharaoh and to his chiefs, but they behaved superciliously and they were haughty.

ayahs.arabicText: فَقَالُوْۤا اَنُؤْمِنُ لِبَشَرَیْنِ مِثْلِنَا وَ قَوْمُهُمَا لَنَا عٰبِدُوْنَۚ
ayahs.translation: They said: "Shall we put faith in two mortals like ourselves when their people are slaves to us?"

ayahs.arabicText: فَكَذَّبُوْهُمَا فَكَانُوْا مِنَ الْمُهْلَكِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: So they rejected them, calling them liars, and they too eventually became of those that were destroyed.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ لَقَدْ اٰتَیْنَا مُوْسَى الْكِتٰبَ لَعَلَّهُمْ یَهْتَدُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: And We gave Moses the Book that people might be guided by it.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ جَعَلْنَا ابْنَ مَرْیَمَ وَ اُمَّهٗۤ اٰیَةً وَّ اٰوَیْنٰهُمَاۤ اِلٰى رَبْوَةٍ ذَاتِ قَرَارٍ وَّ مَعِیْنٍ۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: And We made Mary's son, and his mother, a Sign, and We gave them refuge on a lofty ground, a peaceful site with springs flowing in it.

ayahs.arabicText: یٰۤاَیُّهَا الرُّسُلُ كُلُوْا مِنَ الطَّیِّبٰتِ وَ اعْمَلُوْا صَالِحًا١ؕ اِنِّیْ بِمَا تَعْمَلُوْنَ عَلِیْمٌؕ
ayahs.translation: Messengers! Partake of the things that are clean, and act righteously. I know well all that you do.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اِنَّ هٰذِهٖۤ اُمَّتُكُمْ اُمَّةً وَّاحِدَةً وَّ اَنَا رَبُّكُمْ فَاتَّقُوْنِ
ayahs.translation: This community of yours is one community, and I am your Lord; so hold Me alone in fear.

ayahs.arabicText: فَتَقَطَّعُوْۤا اَمْرَهُمْ بَیْنَهُمْ زُبُرًا١ؕ كُلُّ حِزْبٍۭ بِمَا لَدَیْهِمْ فَرِحُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: But people later cut up their religion into bits, each group rejoicing in what they have.

ayahs.arabicText: فَذَرْهُمْ فِیْ غَمْرَتِهِمْ حَتّٰى حِیْنٍ
ayahs.translation: So leave them immersed in their heedlessness till an appointed time.

ayahs.arabicText: اَیَحْسَبُوْنَ اَنَّمَا نُمِدُّهُمْ بِهٖ مِنْ مَّالٍ وَّ بَنِیْنَۙ
ayahs.translation: Do they fancy that Our continuing to give them wealth and children (means) that

ayahs.arabicText: نُسَارِعُ لَهُمْ فِی الْخَیْرٰتِ١ؕ بَلْ لَّا یَشْعُرُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: We are busy lavishing on them all kinds of good? Nay, they do not perceive the reality of the matter.

ayahs.arabicText: اِنَّ الَّذِیْنَ هُمْ مِّنْ خَشْیَةِ رَبِّهِمْ مُّشْفِقُوْنَۙ
ayahs.translation: Surely those who stand in awe for fear of their Lord,

ayahs.arabicText: وَ الَّذِیْنَ هُمْ بِاٰیٰتِ رَبِّهِمْ یُؤْمِنُوْنَۙ
ayahs.translation: who have full faith in the Signs of their Lord;

ayahs.arabicText: وَ الَّذِیْنَ هُمْ بِرَبِّهِمْ لَا یُشْرِكُوْنَۙ
ayahs.translation: who associate none with their Lord in His Divinity,

ayahs.arabicText: وَ الَّذِیْنَ یُؤْتُوْنَ مَاۤ اٰتَوْا وَّ قُلُوْبُهُمْ وَجِلَةٌ اَنَّهُمْ اِلٰى رَبِّهِمْ رٰجِعُوْنَۙ
ayahs.translation: who give, whatever they give in charity, with their hearts trembling at the thought that they are destined to return to their Lord;

ayahs.arabicText: اُولٰٓئِكَ یُسٰرِعُوْنَ فِی الْخَیْرٰتِ وَ هُمْ لَهَا سٰبِقُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: it is these who hasten to do good works and vie in so doing with one another.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ لَا نُكَلِّفُ نَفْسًا اِلَّا وُسْعَهَا وَ لَدَیْنَا كِتٰبٌ یَّنْطِقُ بِالْحَقِّ وَ هُمْ لَا یُظْلَمُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: We do not lay a burden on anyone beyond his capacity. We have a Book with Us that speaks the truth (about everyone); and they shall in no wise be wronged.

ayahs.arabicText: بَلْ قُلُوْبُهُمْ فِیْ غَمْرَةٍ مِّنْ هٰذَا وَ لَهُمْ اَعْمَالٌ مِّنْ دُوْنِ ذٰلِكَ هُمْ لَهَا عٰمِلُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Nay, their hearts are lost in ignorance of all this; and their deeds too vary from the way (mentioned above). They will persist in these deeds

ayahs.arabicText: حَتّٰۤى اِذَاۤ اَخَذْنَا مُتْرَفِیْهِمْ بِالْعَذَابِ اِذَا هُمْ یَجْئَرُوْنَؕ
ayahs.translation: until We seize with Our chastisement those of them that are given to luxuriant ways. They will then begin to groan.

ayahs.arabicText: لَا تَجْئَرُوا الْیَوْمَ١۫ اِنَّكُمْ مِّنَّا لَا تُنْصَرُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: "Put a stop to your groaning now! Surely no help shall be provided to you from Us.

ayahs.arabicText: قَدْ كَانَتْ اٰیٰتِیْ تُتْلٰى عَلَیْكُمْ فَكُنْتُمْ عَلٰۤى اَعْقَابِكُمْ تَنْكِصُوْنَۙ
ayahs.translation: My Signs were rehearsed to you and you turned back on your heels and took to flight,

ayahs.arabicText: مُسْتَكْبِرِیْنَ١ۖۗ بِهٖ سٰمِرًا تَهْجُرُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: behaving arrogantly, and making fun, and talking nonsense (about the Book in your nightly chats)."

ayahs.arabicText: اَفَلَمْ یَدَّبَّرُوا الْقَوْلَ اَمْ جَآءَهُمْ مَّا لَمْ یَاْتِ اٰبَآءَهُمُ الْاَوَّلِیْنَ٘
ayahs.translation: Did they never ponder over this Word (of God)? Or has he (to wit, the Messenger) brought something the like of which did not come to their forefathers of yore?

ayahs.arabicText: اَمْ لَمْ یَعْرِفُوْا رَسُوْلَهُمْ فَهُمْ لَهٗ مُنْكِرُوْنَ٘
ayahs.translation: Or is it that they were unaware of their Messenger and were therefore repelled by him for he was a stranger to them?

ayahs.arabicText: اَمْ یَقُوْلُوْنَ بِهٖ جِنَّةٌ١ؕ بَلْ جَآءَهُمْ بِالْحَقِّ وَ اَكْثَرُهُمْ لِلْحَقِّ كٰرِهُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Or do they say that there is madness in him? Nay, he has brought them the Truth and it is the Truth that most of them disdain.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ لَوِ اتَّبَعَ الْحَقُّ اَهْوَآءَهُمْ لَفَسَدَتِ السَّمٰوٰتُ وَ الْاَرْضُ وَ مَنْ فِیْهِنَّ١ؕ بَلْ اَتَیْنٰهُمْ بِذِكْرِهِمْ فَهُمْ عَنْ ذِكْرِهِمْ مُّعْرِضُوْنَؕ
ayahs.translation: Were the Truth to follow their desires, the order of the heavens and the earth and those who dwell in them would have been ruined. Nay, the fact is that We have brought to them their own remembrance; and yet it is from their own remembrance that they are turning away.

ayahs.arabicText: اَمْ تَسْئَلُهُمْ خَرْجًا فَخَرَاجُ رَبِّكَ خَیْرٌ١ۖۗ وَّ هُوَ خَیْرُ الرّٰزِقِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: Are you asking them for something? What Allah has given you is the best. He is the Best of providers.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اِنَّكَ لَتَدْعُوْهُمْ اِلٰى صِرَاطٍ مُّسْتَقِیْمٍ
ayahs.translation: You are calling them to a Straight Way,

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اِنَّ الَّذِیْنَ لَا یُؤْمِنُوْنَ بِالْاٰخِرَةِ عَنِ الصِّرَاطِ لَنٰكِبُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: but those who do not believe in the Hereafter are ever prone to deviate from the Right Way.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ لَوْ رَحِمْنٰهُمْ وَ كَشَفْنَا مَا بِهِمْ مِّنْ ضُرٍّ لَّلَجُّوْا فِیْ طُغْیَانِهِمْ یَعْمَهُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Were We to be merciful to them and remove from them their present afflictions, they would persist in their transgression, blindly wandering on.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ لَقَدْ اَخَذْنٰهُمْ بِالْعَذَابِ فَمَا اسْتَكَانُوْا لِرَبِّهِمْ وَ مَا یَتَضَرَّعُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: (They are such) that We seized them with chastisement (and yet) they did not humble themselves before their Lord, nor do they entreat

ayahs.arabicText: حَتّٰۤى اِذَا فَتَحْنَا عَلَیْهِمْ بَابًا ذَا عَذَابٍ شَدِیْدٍ اِذَا هُمْ فِیْهِ مُبْلِسُوْنَ۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: until We opened upon them the door of a severe chastisement. Then lo, in this state they become utterly despaired of any good.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ هُوَ الَّذِیْۤ اَنْشَاَ لَكُمُ السَّمْعَ وَ الْاَبْصَارَ وَ الْاَفْئِدَةَ١ؕ قَلِیْلًا مَّا تَشْكُرُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: It is He Who has endowed you with the faculties of hearing and sight and has given you hearts (to think). Scarcely do you give thanks.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ هُوَ الَّذِیْ ذَرَاَكُمْ فِی الْاَرْضِ وَ اِلَیْهِ تُحْشَرُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: It is He Who has dispersed you all around the earth, and it is unto Him that you shall all be mustered.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ هُوَ الَّذِیْ یُحْیٖ وَ یُمِیْتُ وَ لَهُ اخْتِلَافُ الَّیْلِ وَ النَّهَارِ١ؕ اَفَلَا تَعْقِلُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: It is He Who gives life and causes death, and He holds mastery over the alternation of night and day. Do you not understand this?

ayahs.arabicText: بَلْ قَالُوْا مِثْلَ مَا قَالَ الْاَوَّلُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Nay, but they say the like of what their predecessors of yore had said.

ayahs.arabicText: قَالُوْۤا ءَاِذَا مِتْنَا وَ كُنَّا تُرَابًا وَّ عِظَامًا ءَاِنَّا لَمَبْعُوْثُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: They say: "Is it that when we are dead and have been reduced to dust and bones, shall we then be raised up again?

ayahs.arabicText: لَقَدْ وُعِدْنَا نَحْنُ وَ اٰبَآؤُنَا هٰذَا مِنْ قَبْلُ اِنْ هٰذَاۤ اِلَّاۤ اَسَاطِیْرُ الْاَوَّلِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: We were promised such things and so were our forefathers before us. All these are no more than tales of the past."

ayahs.arabicText: قُلْ لِّمَنِ الْاَرْضُ وَ مَنْ فِیْهَاۤ اِنْ كُنْتُمْ تَعْلَمُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Ask them: "Whose is the earth and those who are in it? Tell us if you know"

ayahs.arabicText: سَیَقُوْلُوْنَ لِلّٰهِ١ؕ قُلْ اَفَلَا تَذَكَّرُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: They will surely say: "Allah's." Say: "Then why do you not take heed?"

ayahs.arabicText: قُلْ مَنْ رَّبُّ السَّمٰوٰتِ السَّبْعِ وَ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِیْمِ
ayahs.translation: Ask them: "Who is the Lord of the seven heavens, the Lord of the Great Throne?"

ayahs.arabicText: سَیَقُوْلُوْنَ لِلّٰهِ١ؕ قُلْ اَفَلَا تَتَّقُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: They will surely say: "Allah." Say: "Will you not, then, fear (Allah)?"

ayahs.arabicText: قُلْ مَنْۢ بِیَدِهٖ مَلَكُوْتُ كُلِّ شَیْءٍ وَّ هُوَ یُجِیْرُ وَ لَا یُجَارُ عَلَیْهِ اِنْ كُنْتُمْ تَعْلَمُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Ask them: "Say, if you indeed know, to whom belongs the dominion over all things; (Who is it) that grants asylum, but against Whom no asylum is available?"

ayahs.arabicText: سَیَقُوْلُوْنَ لِلّٰهِ١ؕ قُلْ فَاَنّٰى تُسْحَرُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: They will surely say: "(The dominion over all things) belongs to Allah." Say: "Whence are you then deluded?"

ayahs.arabicText: بَلْ اَتَیْنٰهُمْ بِالْحَقِّ وَ اِنَّهُمْ لَكٰذِبُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: We have brought before them the Truth, and there is no doubt that they are lying.

ayahs.arabicText: مَا اتَّخَذَ اللّٰهُ مِنْ وَّلَدٍ وَّ مَا كَانَ مَعَهٗ مِنْ اِلٰهٍ اِذًا لَّذَهَبَ كُلُّ اِلٰهٍۭ بِمَا خَلَقَ وَ لَعَلَا بَعْضُهُمْ عَلٰى بَعْضٍ١ؕ سُبْحٰنَ اللّٰهِ عَمَّا یَصِفُوْنَۙ
ayahs.translation: Never did Allah take unto Himself any son, nor is there any god other than He. (Had there been any other gods) each god would have taken his creatures away with him, and each would have rushed to overpower the other. Glory be to Allah from all that they characterize Him with!

ayahs.arabicText: عٰلِمِ الْغَیْبِ وَ الشَّهَادَةِ فَتَعٰلٰى عَمَّا یُشْرِكُوْنَ۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: He knows both what is visible and what is not visible. Exalted is Allah above all that they associate with Him.

ayahs.arabicText: قُلْ رَّبِّ اِمَّا تُرِیَنِّیْ مَا یُوْعَدُوْنَۙ
ayahs.translation: Pray, (O Muhammad): "My Lord, if You should bring the scourge of which they had been warned in my presence,

ayahs.arabicText: رَبِّ فَلَا تَجْعَلْنِیْ فِی الْقَوْمِ الظّٰلِمِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: then do not include me, my Lord, among these wrong-doing people."

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اِنَّا عَلٰۤى اَنْ نُّرِیَكَ مَا نَعِدُهُمْ لَقٰدِرُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Surely We are able to show you what We warn them against.

ayahs.arabicText: اِدْفَعْ بِالَّتِیْ هِیَ اَحْسَنُ السَّیِّئَةَ١ؕ نَحْنُ اَعْلَمُ بِمَا یَصِفُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: (O Muhammad)! Repel evil in the best manner. We are well aware of all that they say about you.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ قُلْ رَّبِّ اَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنْ هَمَزٰتِ الشَّیٰطِیْنِۙ
ayahs.translation: And pray: "My Lord! I seek Your refuge from the suggestions of the evil ones;

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اَعُوْذُ بِكَ رَبِّ اَنْ یَّحْضُرُوْنِ
ayahs.translation: I even seek Your refuge, my Lord, lest they should approach me."

ayahs.arabicText: حَتّٰۤى اِذَا جَآءَ اَحَدَهُمُ الْمَوْتُ قَالَ رَبِّ ارْجِعُوْنِۙ
ayahs.translation: (They shall persist in their deeds) until when death comes to anyone of them he will say: "My Lord, send me back to the world

ayahs.arabicText: لَعَلِّیْۤ اَعْمَلُ صَالِحًا فِیْمَا تَرَكْتُ كَلَّا١ؕ اِنَّهَا كَلِمَةٌ هُوَ قَآئِلُهَا١ؕ وَ مِنْ وَّرَآئِهِمْ بَرْزَخٌ اِلٰى یَوْمِ یُبْعَثُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: that I have left behind. I am likely to do good." Nay, it is merely a word that he is uttering. There is a barrier behind all of them (who are dead) until the Day when they will be raised up.

ayahs.arabicText: فَاِذَا نُفِخَ فِی الصُّوْرِ فَلَاۤ اَنْسَابَ بَیْنَهُمْ یَوْمَئِذٍ وَّ لَا یَتَسَآءَلُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: And then no sooner the Trumpet is blown than there will remain no kinship among them that Day, nor will they ask one another.

ayahs.arabicText: فَمَنْ ثَقُلَتْ مَوَازِیْنُهٗ فَاُولٰٓئِكَ هُمُ الْمُفْلِحُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: It will be an Hour when those whose scales are heavy, they alone will attain success;

ayahs.arabicText: وَ مَنْ خَفَّتْ مَوَازِیْنُهٗ فَاُولٰٓئِكَ الَّذِیْنَ خَسِرُوْۤا اَنْفُسَهُمْ فِیْ جَهَنَّمَ خٰلِدُوْنَۚ
ayahs.translation: and those whose scales are light, those will be the ones who will have courted loss. They will abide in Hell.

ayahs.arabicText: تَلْفَحُ وُجُوْهَهُمُ النَّارُ وَ هُمْ فِیْهَا كٰلِحُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: The Fire shall scorch their faces, exposing their jaws.

ayahs.arabicText: اَلَمْ تَكُنْ اٰیٰتِیْ تُتْلٰى عَلَیْكُمْ فَكُنْتُمْ بِهَا تُكَذِّبُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: "Are you not those to whom My revelations were recited, and you dubbed them as lies?"

ayahs.arabicText: قَالُوْا رَبَّنَا غَلَبَتْ عَلَیْنَا شِقْوَتُنَا وَ كُنَّا قَوْمًا ضَآلِّیْنَ
ayahs.translation: They will say: "Our Lord! Our misfortune prevailed over us. We were indeed an erring people.

ayahs.arabicText: رَبَّنَاۤ اَخْرِجْنَا مِنْهَا فَاِنْ عُدْنَا فَاِنَّا ظٰلِمُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Our Lord! Take us out of this. Then if we revert (to evil-doing) we shall indeed be wrongdoers."

ayahs.arabicText: قَالَ اخْسَئُوْا فِیْهَا وَ لَا تُكَلِّمُوْنِ
ayahs.translation: Allah will say: "Away from Me; stay where you are and do not address Me.

ayahs.arabicText: اِنَّهٗ كَانَ فَرِیْقٌ مِّنْ عِبَادِیْ یَقُوْلُوْنَ رَبَّنَاۤ اٰمَنَّا فَاغْفِرْ لَنَا وَ ارْحَمْنَا وَ اَنْتَ خَیْرُ الرّٰحِمِیْنَۚۖ
ayahs.translation: You are those that when a party of My servants said: 'Our Lord, we believe, so forgive us, and have mercy on us, for You are the Best of those that are merciful,'

ayahs.arabicText: فَاتَّخَذْتُمُوْهُمْ سِخْرِیًّا حَتّٰۤى اَنْسَوْكُمْ ذِكْرِیْ وَ كُنْتُمْ مِّنْهُمْ تَضْحَكُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: you made a laughingstock of them and your hostility to them caused you to forget Me, and you simply kept laughing.

ayahs.arabicText: اِنِّیْ جَزَیْتُهُمُ الْیَوْمَ بِمَا صَبَرُوْۤا١ۙ اَنَّهُمْ هُمُ الْفَآئِزُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Lo! I have rewarded them this Day for their steadfastness, so that they, and they alone, are triumphant."

ayahs.arabicText: قٰلَ كَمْ لَبِثْتُمْ فِی الْاَرْضِ عَدَدَ سِنِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: Then Allah will ask them: "For how many years did you stay on earth?"

ayahs.arabicText: قَالُوْا لَبِثْنَا یَوْمًا اَوْ بَعْضَ یَوْمٍ فَسْئَلِ الْعَآدِّیْنَ
ayahs.translation: They will say: "We stayed for a day or part of a day. Ask of those who keep count of this."

ayahs.arabicText: قٰلَ اِنْ لَّبِثْتُمْ اِلَّا قَلِیْلًا لَّوْ اَنَّكُمْ كُنْتُمْ تَعْلَمُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: He will say: "You stayed only for a while, if you only knew that.

ayahs.arabicText: اَفَحَسِبْتُمْ اَنَّمَا خَلَقْنٰكُمْ عَبَثًا وَّ اَنَّكُمْ اِلَیْنَا لَا تُرْجَعُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Did you imagine that We created you without any purpose, and that you will not be brought back to Us?"

ayahs.arabicText: فَتَعٰلَى اللّٰهُ الْمَلِكُ الْحَقُّ١ۚ لَاۤ اِلٰهَ اِلَّا هُوَ١ۚ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْكَرِیْمِ
ayahs.translation: So, exalted be Allah, the True King! There is no god but He, the Lord of the Great Throne.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ مَنْ یَّدْعُ مَعَ اللّٰهِ اِلٰهًا اٰخَرَ١ۙ لَا بُرْهَانَ لَهٗ بِهٖ١ۙ فَاِنَّمَا حِسَابُهٗ عِنْدَ رَبِّهٖ١ؕ اِنَّهٗ لَا یُفْلِحُ الْكٰفِرُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: He who invokes any other god along with Allah " one for whom he has no evidence" his reckoning is with his Lord alone. Indeed, these unbelievers shall not prosper.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ قُلْ رَّبِّ اغْفِرْ وَ ارْحَمْ وَ اَنْتَ خَیْرُ الرّٰحِمِیْنَ۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: And say, (O Muhammad): "My Lord, forgive us and have mercy on us, for You are the Best of those that are merciful."
